title: Generative Model Unlearning: A Survey through Target Events, Unlearning Operators, and Evaluation Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2507.19894v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the rapid advancement of generative models, privacy, copyright, safety, and reliability risks have attracted growing attention. To mitigate these risks, machine unlearning has been increasingly adapted from traditional classification models to generative settings. Despite notable progress, existing studies remain fragmented in their target definitions, unlearning mechanisms, and evaluation protocols, making objective comparison difficult across models, modalities, and applications. Moreover, modality-specific surveys often overlook the shared structure of Generative Model Unlearning (GenMU). To address this gap, we provide a comprehensive review of GenMU and formulate it as target-constrained distributional projection: given a target event, an unlearning operator transforms the generative distribution to suppress target-related outputs while preserving useful behavior and controlling operator cost. translated_title: 生成模型反学习：基于目标事件、反学习操作符与评估协议的综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.19894v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：随着生成模型的快速发展，隐私、版权、安全和可靠性风险日益受到关注。为缓解这些风险，机器反学习已逐渐从传统分类模型扩展到生成设置中。尽管取得了显著进展，现有研究在目标定义、反学习机制和评估协议方面仍然零散，导致跨模型、跨模态和跨应用的客观比较困难。此外，针对特定模态的综述往往忽视了生成模型反学习（GenMU）的共享结构。为弥补这一空白，我们对GenMU进行了全面回顾，并将其形式化为目标约束的分布投影：给定一个目标事件，反学习操作符转换生成分布，以抑制与目标相关的输出，同时保留有用行为并控制操作符成本。在此框架下，一个反学习...
tldr: 本文首次系统化生成模型反学习（GenMU）为一个统一框架——目标约束的分布投影，通过综述目标事件、反学习操作符和评估协议，解决了跨模态研究碎片化的问题，为客观比较提供了理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically formalizes Generative Model Unlearning (GenMU) into a unified framework—target-constrained distributional projection—by reviewing target events, unlearning operators, and evaluation protocols, addressing fragmentation across modalities and enabling objective comparisons.
